title: get_game_state turn counter stuck at initial value for entire game
description:
In game_20260215_103054_g1, DSV3 Libby's get_game_state always returned `"turn":2` even when the actual game was at turn 15+. The game_events.jsonl correctly shows TURN 15 at that point.

This caused the model to believe creatures cast earlier in the game had summoning sickness: "p11 entered this turn, so it has summoning sickness. But the game allowed me to declare it as an attacker. That's strange." (seq=231). In reality, p11 (Duelist of the Mind) had been on the battlefield since Turn 7 (game_events seq=94-95) and was correctly attackable.

The turn counter shown via get_game_state at seq=89, seq=124, and seq=217 all showed turn=2. The get_action_choices context field shows "T2" as well. Meanwhile the game_events.jsonl shows the correct turn progression from turn 1 through 18+.

This may be a bug in how GameView.getTurn() is populated or how the MCP layer reads it. Note: the game_events.jsonl correctly tracks turns, so the issue is specifically in the game state returned to the LLM.

Key log references:
- game_20260215_103054_g1/DSV3 Libby_llm.jsonl seq=217 (get_game_state returns turn=2 when actual is ~15)
- game_20260215_103054_g1/DSV3 Libby_llm.jsonl seq=231 (model confused about summoning sickness)
- game_20260215_103054_g1/game_events.jsonl seq=248 (actual TURN 15)
